summary: Bind common Python tool caches to project execution scratch

delivery.outcome: Bind pip, uv and XDG caches to reusable checkout-owned ignored directories while retaining separate per-run temporary scratch and canonical interpreter admission.
nonGoals: No filesystem sandbox, universal cache interception, global cache deletion, dependency installation, SDK pin relaxation or worker source enrollment.

architecture.decision: Extend the existing project execution boundary with deterministic checkout-local pip/uv/XDG cache bindings. Reuse one private-directory implementation for operational directory creation, validate redirects during read-only admission, retain stable caches across launches and separate UUID temporary directories. Record the bound cache map as an additive local observation.
interfaceChanges: Execution context adds the checkout-owned tool cache map.
architecture.rollback: Revert the bounded implementation; retain old pinned tool artifacts and leave generated caches available for explicitly authorized cleanup.

validation.evidence: Real child writes prove project ownership, cross-run reuse, inherited-cache override and no write through symlink/file destinations; dry-run stays read-only.
Native project environment, exact committed range, protected OneDev verification and independent Validator publication.
